body: Large Language Model judges are widely used to rank texts and text-generating systems through pairwise comparison, and their reliability is typically assessed via three proxies: position bias, transitivity, and pairwise agreement (self- or human-labeled). Because these proxies drive judge selection and benchmarking, a substantial literature reporting that judges perform poorly on them risks steering practitioners away from otherwise capable evaluators. We argue this assessment is misleading. Under the Bradley--Terry geometry underlying pairwise aggregation, each proxy is dominated by close-rank-gap pairs, where inconsistency is information-theoretically expected and individual verdicts contribute little to the aggregate ranking; far-gap pairs carry the ranking signal but barely move the proxies. We formalize this argument and validate it in a controlled simulation and on two human-rated corpora: the proxies correlate only weakly with ranking accuracy against gold, and their predictive component concentrates in the far-gap regime. Judges should therefore be assessed on rank-gap-conditional metrics, ideally against human rankings. Code at https://github.com/brunobrocai/PairDifficulty.
summaryZh: 本文重新审视了基于成对比较的LLM裁判评估机制。研究指出，现有的位置偏差、传递性和一致性等代理指标在处理“近距离差距”对时存在信息论上的不确定性，导致评估结果产生误导。作者通过模拟和人类标注语料验证了这一观点，并建议采用基于排序差距（rank-gap-conditional）的指标来更准确地衡量LLM裁判的性能，为大模型评估体系提供了重要的理论修正。

glossary.explanationZh: 利用大语言模型对其他模型的输出进行评分或排序的评估范式。
一种用于预测成对比较结果的统计模型。
模型在评估时倾向于选择特定位置（如第一个）选项的偏见。
评估逻辑的一致性，即若A优于B且B优于C，则A应优于C。
在成对比较中，两个被评估对象之间质量或得分的差距。
